macros.name: shrinkheight
macros.doc: The allowed maximimum height of a part of the supertabular on a page can be adjusted using the command \shrinkheight. It takes one argument, the length with which to shrink (positive value) or grow (negative value) the allowed height.

macros.name: tablefirsthead
macros.doc: The command \tablefirsthead takes one argument, it defines the contents of the first occurence of the tabular head.

macros.name: tablelasttail
macros.doc: The command \tablelasttail takes one argument, it defines something which should be inserted before the last \end{tabular}.

macros.name: tabletail
macros.doc: The command \tabletail takes one argument, it defines something which should be inserted before each \end{tabular}, except the last.

macros.name: topcaption
macros.doc: The user-commands \topcaption and \bottomcaption set the flag @topcaption to determine where to put the tablecaption.

macros.name: topcaption
macros.doc: The user-commands \topcaption and \bottomcaption set the flag @topcaption to determine where to put the tablecaption.

envs.name: supertabular
envs.doc: The package supertabular offers a new environment, the supertabular environment. As the name indicates it is an extension of the normal tabular environment.
